summary_1line: Madhavi rejects all suitors to embrace forest asceticism, while in heaven King Yayati grows proud and begins to lose recognition and splendour.

image_candidates.scene_text: Before a vast gathering at the Ganga–Yamuna hermitage, Madhavi steps down from her flower-decked chariot and walks alone into the forest instead of choosing a husband.
In heaven, King Yayati sits among radiant sages and gods while they look at him with puzzlement, none recognizing the once-glorious monarch.
The hermitage clearing crowded with Nagas, Yakshas, sages, animals, and birds gathered for the swayamvara at the sacred river confluence.
